extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from primary text, figures, and supplementary figure/table locators.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper supports antibacterial and antibiofilm efficacy against A. veronii ACCC61732, including MIC, PAE, biofilm inhibition/eradication, and mouse infection outcomes.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: N6NH2, DN6NH2, N6PNH2, V112N6NH2, Guo-N6NH2, and CIP comparator as reported.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Phenotypic efficacy does not by itself prove a single molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Membrane interaction is directly supported by outer membrane penetration, cytoplasmic membrane potential/permeability, ATP-release, microscopy, and Table S7 permeability evidence.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: N6NH2 analogs against A. veronii ACCC61732.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Relative membrane effects differ by analog and concentration; V112N6NH2 biofilm crystal-violet readouts are explicitly unreliable because of precipitated material/OMV context.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Genomic DNA interaction is supported by gel-block and CD assays, with DN6NH2 reported as the strongest DNA-migration inhibitor among the analogs.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: N6NH2 analogs and A. veronii ACCC61732 genomic DNA.
mechanism_claims.limitations: DNA interaction is one supported mechanism component, not an exclusive target claim.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Low hemolysis/cytotoxicity is supported qualitatively by Figure 1 and text; exact external database percentages are not tabulated locally.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: N6NH2 and analogs in mouse erythrocytes and RAW 264.7 cells.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not promote database exact hemolysis percentages to source_verified table values without figure digitization.
